name: John R. Wilson
mentions: John R. Wilson, of Deadwood, recent democratic candidate for delegate to congress, arrived with his wife from Deadwood yesterday. They intend visiting friends in the east, and will att…

The following were among the passengers from the Hills: Hon. John R. Wilson and wife, Hon. A. McCall, Hon. H. A. Sprague, Hon. H. M. Gregg, J. A. Bishop, Kane Holland, Hon. G. T. Bennett and John P. Belding, sheriff of Lawrence county.
